remarks:
Picturesque building lot near in Cuba, NY
Just minutes east of Cuba, and minutes west of Friendship, this lot is one of four southern exposure lots that is right sized for plenty of privacy and enjoying the country living experience in the rolling hills of Allegany County. Pretty views await you looking out the back door of your dream home. The road frontage is maintained being a designated county route, (CR 20) also knows as the Cuba Friendship Road, and electric service and internet is at the road.
This property has double road frontage on CR 20 and on Summit road.
Currently the property has been an ag field, with hedge rows separating the parcels.  So no meaningful landscaping is required to plan your dream home location. The property is gently sloped and high and dry of wetlands where you might consider building a home. Just 4.05 miles from the charming town of Cuba and 2.43 miles to town of Friendship, all of your conveniences are close by. If you are a commuter, the Southern Tier Expressway (I-86) is merely 2.6 miles away to larger city centers like Olean, and Hornell. 
If hobby farming or if you’re looking to start a farmette, combing a couple of lots might be considered as well.
Call today for more details or to schedule a showing!
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Timber and GMO rights convey, Pastures, Electric at the road, 4.05 miles to Cuba,  2.43 miles to Friendship, 2.6 miles to I-86. Taxes will be reassessed after closing.  this is part of a larger parcel. Building permits are subject to buyers approval from town authorities.
